_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for this storefront's look + content. To clone this template into a NEW store: copy the app, then edit THIS file (brand, colors, font sizes, nav, hero, tiles, testimonials). No component code changes needed. Font sizes are real CSS sizes (rem/px/clamp) — tune them here.

brand.name: ALPHA FOR BABY
brand.tagline: Thoughtfully designed baby essentials in premium organic cotton. Made for the moments that matter.
brand.copyright: © 2026 ALPHA FOR BABY · Free shipping on all orders · 30-day returns

_legal_note: TEMPLATE, NOT LEGAL ADVICE. Fill the empty fields below with your REAL registered business details and have a lawyer review before going live. Do NOT invent a fake address (Google/Meta/Stripe ban for misrepresentation). Empty fields are hidden or shown as a clearly-marked TODO. Cookie/CCPA consent is handled by Shopify's built-in Privacy Banner (root.jsx withPrivacyBanner + admin → Settings → Customer privacy).

returns.condition: unused, in original packaging, with tags attached

_legalLinks_note: Shipping/Refund/Privacy/Terms are pulled LIVE from Shopify (admin → Settings → Legal). Accessibility + Contact are template pages (Shopify has no generator for them).
_tokens_note: 2026-08-02: retextured to the 'Classical' cream/accent design system from the product-page handoff (see tailwind.config.js + app/styles/app.css .pdp block for the fuller token set). ink/muted/line/soft/heroAccent map onto Classical's ink/muted(derived)/divider/surface/accent so the whole site (header, footer, cart, account) re-themes through the existing --tob-* pipeline, not just the product page.
